label: Pot timing
tooltip: When to leave for pots, when to skip late pots, and reroll chests. The next-pot prediction clears if you leave Occult Crescent or change instance.

max_pot_fate_progress_percent.label: Skip pots at or above (% progress)
max_pot_fate_progress_percent.tooltip: Do not path to a pot FATE that is already this far along. Once you are in the pot, BOCCHI stays to finish. 0 = never skip for progress. Default 50%.

min_pot_fate_minutes_remaining.label: Skip pots with under (minutes left)
min_pot_fate_minutes_remaining.tooltip: Optional extra skip: do not path to a pot with fewer minutes left than this. 0 = off (progress % above is enough for most people).

pot_spawn_lead_minutes.label: Leave for pots this many minutes early
pot_spawn_lead_minutes.tooltip: Minutes before the predicted pot spawn to stop other work and head to pots (Illegal Mode and Pots & Treasure). Timer resets when you leave OC or hop instances.

fate_fallback_cutoff_minutes.label: Do not start FATEs within (minutes of pots)
fate_fallback_cutoff_minutes.tooltip: Do not start a normal FATE when pot departure is this close. 0 = no cutoff.

ce_fallback_cutoff_minutes.label: Do not start CEs within (minutes of pots)
ce_fallback_cutoff_minutes.tooltip: Do not start a Critical Encounter when pot departure is this close. 0 = no cutoff.

should_farm_reroll_pot_chests.label: Also farm reroll pot chests
should_farm_reroll_pot_chests.tooltip: After a pot FATE chest run, also visit the shared reroll chest spots (while Cache Me is still up).
